title: Pocketwire Personal Account Purchase Protection at a Glance
content:
Purchase protection on the Pocketwire Personal Account has two plan figures: how long after a goods-and-services payment a claim is accepted, and the maximum reimbursable amount of one claim.

| Plan | Claim window (calendar days after the goods-and-services payment's transaction date) | Maximum reimbursable amount of one claim (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 180 | 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Core | 180 | 2500.00 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 180 | 5000.00 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 180 | 10000.00 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 180 | 15000.00 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 180 | 25000.00 |

The claim window is the same 180 days on every plan; the maximum amount rises with the plan, from 500.00 on Pocketwire Lite to 25000.00 on Pocketwire Summit.
